card.name: The word Use starting a sentence or cross-reference
card.fires_on: The word "Use" or "used" when it begins an instruction sentence, or follows "see" in a section cross-reference such as "Use in Specific Populations". Also "used" after a drug name, meaning "used to treat".

modes.label: Sentence-opening Use
modes.description: "Use" starts a new sentence as a directive after a period or bullet.
modes.example: Supervise children in the use of this product.<< Use>> under the direction of a licensed medical practitioner

modes.label: See Use in Specific Populations
modes.description: "Use" is the first word of a section title inside a cross-reference after "see".

modes.description: "used" follows a drug name and introduces its purpose.
